name: Kairaku no Ori
source:
Oh shit! A travelling hero's been captured by succubi!
That sucks. Or does it? In one sense, maybe...

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ276828.html/?locale=en_US]DLsite English[/url]]
